recommendation.reason: This closes the missing dependency between authored wording and byte evidence. Supplying two expected/observed windows today does not establish that either side represents the canonical plan. The historical shared ground_truth report actually re-encodes registry EN against original source context before comparing installed bytes.
recommendation.owner: Enhance auditStreams only for a finite explicitly declared canonical cohort; reuse controls, encode, glyphMaps, references(reference_observed), inspect(elf_layout), current pin/recheck/report lifecycle. No new function, decoder, mapper, writer or speculative orchestration engine is justified by this study.
recommendation.not_a_schema_decision: Selection/authoring-policy representation remains for root to decide before code. The fixture context-selections.json is neutral evidence data, not a proposed runtime API. Optional behavior must preserve existing plain/bound profiles and report bytes.
recommendation.do_first: Use the already registry-bound narrative cohort rather than adding a separate CLI or pretending the mutating planner is a read-only report.

The additional redundant-prefix-stripped convention is explicit historical policy; do not try alternatives until one matches and call that an unqualified canonical plan.

ground_truth_main resolves actual declared refs, detects divergent targets, decodes installed bytes, re-encodes expected source-aware content, and distinguishes exact match/wrong content/encode unavailable/decode failure. It additionally owns live sentinel-hook range derivation and stale/undeclared sentinel lists, which this finite ELF cohort does not replace.

jp_prologue/jp_structure preserve original prologue order, initial speaker and structural final pause; box classifiers choose horizontal/vertical authoring budgets. These budgets are semantic input, not a decoded native GUI or safe visual fit claim.

encode_stream/encode_entry_from_elf define source-aware authoring, wrapping and final pause; unsupported content controls require a different proven policy. Historical setup/colour prologues are broader than the current Go source-context allowlist. Never silently drop them.

live_targets + audit demonstrate independently reading original/observed argument sequences. Legacy fallback-to-ID and error-dropping are unsafe to transfer as observation; FAULT/SHIFT/GARBLE/SWAP are advisory classifications, not exact canonical content proof.
Its many reader/source-pool-specific native, battle/board, fixed and custom rows are distinct material report responsibilities. A generic narrative cohort is not full ledger parity.
Normalized wording/rough byte lengths and ledger/status reconciliation are separate from exact installed byte/control identity. They must not replace exact canonical comparison.

required_data_and_pipeline: Canonical wording comes from the hash-pinned registry EN of the normalized selected ID, never from a supplied expected byte buffer, rendered/normalized observed text or status field. Missing/non-string/empty authoring wording must not accidentally match an empty stream; preserve planner refusal policy explicitly.

Original context comes from the separately pinned reference source and explicit bounded baseline FILE window. Its independent identity and actual decoded tokens must be reported. Registry ID is a logical join key, not fallback physical address. The reference window need not be the same size as generated canonical bytes.

An explicit recipe/source convention supplies narrative source-context and exact wrapping policy (or a deliberately explicit no-wrap convention). Do not silently infer historical 22x3 or source geometry from registry status/event names. Existing planner SourceContext requires Layout; any read-only policy must document its equivalence/limits rather than bypass that fact. The literal corpus has an explicit 2-column/2-row case; its other short words use no-wrap semantics, not a claim that every historical default was reproduced.

Use the existing controls decode with English to determine readiness, then existing encode(Source) with the declared policy. Keep source-aware original prologue/speaker/final PAGE semantics; no content-normalization success, redundant-prefix retries, hidden wrapping, fixed-field interpretation or raw control stripping.

Independently resolve every declared selected observed site from the observed ELF and same pinned registry, demand >=1 valid site and a single converged target, then require the COMPLETE explicit observed window including tail be one file-backed mapping at exactly that target. Preserve current failure/no-JSON binding semantics, caps and normalized-ID ownership.

Compare canonical bytes to observed consumed through-END bytes, retaining exact glyph/control positions/control sequence/argument/payload factors through the existing scanner. Separately retain original-vs-observed and pointer movement facts. Report post-END tail without inventing a canonical slot fill policy.

Failed canonical generation leaves canonical comparison unknown, not false or PASS. Failed observed decoding leaves raw bounded bytes/hash/difference known but consumed semantic comparisons unknown. Strict binding/pin failures remain distinct from byte mismatch. Exact success says declared installed content matches this declared authoring convention; no English quality, liveness, physical fit, all-game or patch approval.
Recheck registry, profile, glyphmap, source handles and identities through existing lifecycle before publishing; no audit mutation/status updates, file patch or registry writeback.

independent_literal_cohort.independence: Only stdlib AST slicing/struct/JSON/hash and manual literal arrays were used. No Go/candidate/project encoder/decoder, historical module import/main, native protected source or canonical registry was read. Existing implementation predates study; these vectors are frozen before future candidate comparison on this new cohort, not claimed original pre-implementation fixtures.
independent_literal_cohort.fixtures: Two4096B ELF32LE MIPS sources, one PT_LOAD with different source/observed landing windows, eleven canonical registry rows and reversible deterministic glyphmap. Pointers are actual little-endian source facts; expected bytes are diagnostic oracle files only. Missing/divergent-site registries provide hard binding refusals.
required_nontrivial_facts: Canonical A|B with source HDR/speaker/final pause has literal words 2800 3801 0001 0800 0002 1000 f800.

Observed original J differs from that canonical encoding, but another row whose canonical EN is J matches both JP and canonical despite a relocated pointer. Thus JP equality alone is not untranslated proof.
PAGE-vs-LINE can preserve glyph order yet change canonical bytes and control sequence.
Argument7001 differs from declared/canonical7000 even with same glyphs; param8 payload words f800/7000/2800 are opaque bytes, never END/argument/header.
Matching through-END bytes plus1234 tail is a canonical consumed-stream match with separate raw-tail fact; no fixed-slot policy is implied.
AA BB under explicit2x2 authoring budget yields 2800 3801 0001 0001 0800 0002 0002 1000 f800.
Setup prologue4001 is held by existing Go source-context allowlist even though original historical prologue is broader.
